admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
Weekly digest

Hello! Your weekly digest is ready to go. Each Sunday it gathers your practice minutes and the number of check-ins you completed; it never includes the words you write in your journal. The digest is sent to the supporter account linked to your profile, so the people there can cheer you on. If you would rather keep it to yourself, open Settings and switch Sharing off. You can change this whenever you like.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b:
Weekly digest - how it works

- Every Sunday the digest gathers your practice minutes and the number of check-ins you completed.
- It never includes the words you write in your journal.
- It can go to the supporter account linked to your profile, so the people there can cheer you on.
- Nothing is sent to them until you open Settings and switch Sharing on.
- You can change this whenever you like.
